description: Explains e-invoice validation errors by rule ID: XRechnung (e.g. BR-DE-15), EN 16931 as used by ZUGFeRD/Factur-X (e.g. BR-CO-15, BR-S-08) and Romanian e-Factura CIUS-RO (e.g. BR-RO-110), in English or Romanian. Fits questions about what a validation error means and how such errors are usually fixed. Returns the rule text quoted from the pinned official artefact with its version and licence, the business terms (BT/BG) concerned and, for common rules, a short fix note. Deterministic lookup; unknown IDs are reported as not found. Does not cover KSeF FA(3) schema messages or other national rule sets, and does not check files (validate_einvoice does).

lang.description: Language of the fix notes and summary: en (default) or ro (Romanian; CIUS-RO rule texts in their official Romanian wording).

rule_ids.description: Rule IDs as shown in a validation report or error message, e.g. BR-DE-15, BR-CO-10, BR-RO-110 (up to 20).

name: explain_validation_rule
